pages.title: Blood and Fire
pages.text: Use a Blood Sword or Axe special action and equip an acquired Holy Robe piece.

pages.title: Blood and Fire
pages.text: Blood and Demon Flesh supply further blood equipment without replacing acquisition of Holy Robes.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sword fires a piercing slash and Axe creates vortices; blood armor protects more at low health. Holy Robes have defense/fire-ring behavior. Do not deliberately lower health or obtain the robe as a free quest reward.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Crystallized Blood Sword or Axe and wear their armor. Sword fires a piercing slash, axe produces surrounding vortices, and armor becomes more protective at low health.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wear Holy Robe pieces during combat. Their native description reduces incoming damage and may create a defensive fire ring.
